SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'core' AND package = 'click')
  AND s.qualname LIKE 'Group.%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.symbols base_s
    WHERE base_s.file_id = s.file_id
      AND base_s.qualname = 'Command'
      AND base_s.kind = 'class'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM code.class_bases cb
      WHERE cb.class_symbol_id = base_s.symbol_id
        AND cb.base_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
    )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c
    WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
      AND c.callee_symbol_id = (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE qualname = 'Command' AND file_id = s.file_id)
      AND c.call_kind = 'override'
  )
ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds Group methods in src/click/core.py that override a Command method with the same name. It first identifies Group methods, then checks if Command (the direct base class in the same file) defines a method of that name, and finally verifies an override call exists from the Group method to the Command method.

FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'core' AND package = 'click')

    FROM code.symbols base_s
    WHERE base_s.file_id = s.file_id
      AND base_s.qualname = 'Command'
      AND base_s.kind = 'class'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM code.class_bases cb
      WHERE cb.class_symbol_id = base_s.symbol_id
        AND cb.base_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
    )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c
    WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
      AND c.callee_symbol_id = (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE qualname = 'Command' AND file_id = s.file_id)
